Space Engineers - Colony Survival - Ep #1 - CHAOS! · 22:23

Join Captain Jack and friends in an epic adventure across 4 series in Space Engineers Multiplayer Survival. 

Starting out with Colony Survival, where 10 players survive together in the harsh world. Following into Colony WARS, with two teams fighting against each other. Finally Colony LOST sees all-out war break out in the galaxy, as Captain Jack's team fights to save what everyone knows as home. 

Series Order:

Colony Survival - Colony WARS - Colony LOST - Colony ALLIANCES
